Meet Chat AI 5: AI Agent & Video, built on a powerful matrix of Google Gemini 3.1 Pro, Nano Banana Pro, Gemini 3.5 Flash, OpenAI GPT-5.5 Thinking, and Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5 models, brings powerful voice-first AI features including hands-free document creation, deep research, image and video generation, and intelligent answers for all your needs.

Discover the power of true Voice-First AI. Go beyond typing and command your digital world with just your voice. Let the creative engine of OpenAI's GPT-5.5 Thinking turn spoken ideas into visual art, or let Google Gemini 3.1 Pro draft professional documents instantly.

Our AI assistant can do many tasks with endless possibilities:

VOICE-FIRST IMAGE GENERATOR
Speak your ideas into existence! With the visual prowess of Google Gemini 3.1 Pro, Nano Banana Pro, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and OpenAI GPT-5.5 Thinking, command the AI to create stunning art, architectural mockups, or interior design concepts just by talking.

AI VIDEO GENERATOR
Bring your ideas to life in motion. Just describe a scene with your voice and let the AI generate dynamic, high-quality videos from your text or photos. Create short clips, animate static images, and transform creative concepts into shareable video content in seconds.

GET INSTANT ANSWERS
Thanks to our Smart AI Routing, you always get the most accurate and nuanced response. We leverage Google Gemini 3.1 Pro for deep analysis and OpenAI's GPT-5.5 for creative questions, ensuring the best model answers you.

DEEP RESEARCH
Unlock deep insights into your studies or work. Our AI performs in-depth analysis by tasking Google Gemini 3.1 Pro with gathering and cross-referencing complex data, while OpenAI's GPT-5.5 Thinking synthesizes the findings into a structured report.

AI WRITING ASSISTANT
- Generate outlines or full drafts for emails, blogs, and marketing copy.
- Brainstorm creative ideas for any project.
- Refine your text to perfection with advanced grammar and style suggestions.

COMPLETE DOCUMENT SUITE
Your all-in-one mobile office, powered by voice. Dictate and create professional documents in Word (doc, docx), Excel, and PowerPoint (pptx) formats on the fly.

PDF MASTER
Summarize, rewrite, or translate any PDF document. Upload a file and use your voice to ask questions about the content, or use the built-in editor and scanner to sign & fill forms.

DATA ANALYST
Turn raw data into clear insights. Simply describe your data and ask the AI to generate charts, visualize trends, and provide key analysis without writing a single formula.

Step into the future of productivity and creativity. Our commitment is to continuously refine and expand our features, harnessing the combined power of Google Gemini 3.1 Pro, Nano Banana Pro, Gemini 3.5 Flash, OpenAI GPT-5.5 Thinking, and Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5. Download Chat AI 5: AI Agent & Video today and experience the next generation of artificial intelligence at your command.

FULL ACCESS TO ALL FEATURES
Chat AI 5 is free to download. Full access to all features — including AI image and video generation, Deep Research, the Document Suite, PDF Master, Data Analyst, and advanced AI models — requires a paid subscription or a one-time purchase. Choose the plan that works best for you, and manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
